subject: E-Commerce
title: Faire: The Wholesale Marketplace
description: Learn Faire: The Wholesale Marketplace in one minute.

hook.text: Faire connects 100K+ independent brands with 700K retailers. It's the marketplace for businesses that sell to other.

buildup.text: Small retailers used to find products at trade shows. Faire brought the trade show online with a wholesale marketplace.

discovery.text: Faire offers net-60 terms and free returns for retailers. It removed the risk of stocking unknown brands.

twist.text: Faire takes 15-25% from brands—a high price for access. But for small brands, it's their only path to retail shelves.

climax.text: B2B marketplaces face the same dynamics as B2C: network effects, rising fees, and seller dependency.

quiz.question: What risk does Faire remove for retailers buying from unknown brands?
options: Financial risk through net-60 payment terms and free returns on unsold inventory
